label: caiso 38 delivered gas
definition: caiso-38 replaces CAISO's EIA-923 gas price series (7-plant NorCal/SDG&E-skewed sample, $4.45/MMBtu 2024) with the measured SoCal/PG&E Citygate hub basis overlay (gas_hub_basis_overlay: EIA N3050CA3 - Henry Hub from gas_basis_by_iso_month.csv, the same mechanism as NEISO doc-08), reconciled up to the full-census CA electric-power delivered price (EIA N3045CA3 $3.84) via the measured citygate-to-burner-tip intrastate-transport adder (CAISO_CITYGATE_TRANSPORT_ADDER +0.46 = N3045CA3 - N3050CA3 2024), so the marginal CC bids its true delivered fuel cost rather than the skewed 7-plant estimate — measured, forward-reproducible, not residual-tuned (rule #11). Headline: CA-zone (NP15/ZP26/SP15) demand-weighted LMP fell 95.7/61.0/64.8 → 85.7/57.1/62.5 $/MWh (2023/24/25; actual 43.8/33.0/33.6), but interchange regressed +1.33/+0.12/+2.78 → −2.38/−5.46/— TWh because the corrected lower gas exposed an import-ATC miscalibration that the inflated gas price had been masking — a discovered structural bug (rule #11), not a reason to revert. All caiso-37 offer-curve + seam levers carried verbatim; ERCOT/PJM/NYISO/NEISO byte-identical. NOT-YET: C1 (CC_REGULAR over-run, CT_PEAKER under-run 2023/24), C2 (2025 gas), C3a/b/c (LMP body/shape/tail), C4 (dispatch correlation), C5a (CO2) all remain open MODEL MISS; C6 governance unattested.
